visual.zh: 翼肋、张线与展开的翼面强调早期飞机轻盈而受力明确的结构。画面借用了飞行器的形态，没有复刻某架飞机的尺寸或结构图。
visual.en: Wing ribs, bracing wires and fabric-like surfaces evoke the lightweight structure of early aircraft. The image borrows their forms without reproducing a specific aircraft’s dimensions or plans.

background.zh: 1903 年 12 月 17 日，奥维尔·莱特驾驶飞行器完成约 12 秒、120 英尺的首次飞行。NASA 记载，兄弟二人当天共飞行四次。这个具体起点提醒我们，持续、可控制的动力飞行来自反复试验，而不是只有一次灵光闪现。
background.en: On December 17, 1903, Orville Wright made a first flight lasting about 12 seconds over 120 feet. NASA records four flights that day. This measured beginning illustrates how sustained, controlled powered flight emerged through repeated experiments.

sources.label: NASA · 120th Anniversary of the First Powered, Controlled Flight
